Valorisation des compétences estudiantin: Enhancement of student skills and technological innovation
L'événement s'est déroulé en présence du: The event took place in the presence of the Minister of Communication, Mr. Mohamed Bouslimani, as well as representatives of public institutions, teachers, press professionals, and digital transformation experts. The guests were welcomed by Mr. Roni TOHME, General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, accompanied by senior executives of the group. For this third edition, the candidates worked on the theme "Artificial intelligence and the future of information in Algeria: challenges and prospects".
Au total, soixante-six étudiants venus d: In total, sixty-six students from the Higher School of Journalism as well as faculties of Information and Communication Sciences across the national territory took part in the events. A jury chaired by Prof. Abdesslam Benzaoui, former director of ENSJI, evaluated the productions according to criteria of relevance, originality, and analytical rigor. At the end of the deliberations, eleven winners were rewarded in four distinct categories: written, digital, radio, and audiovisual reports.
S'exprimant lors de la cérémonie, M. Ron: Speaking during the ceremony, Mr. Roni TOHME stated: "We are particularly proud to celebrate today the excellence of our young students who took part in this third edition of the Rising Star. This competition, which grows in scale year after year, is the perfect illustration of the pool of excellence and creativity that Algerian universities harbor. Today, we celebrate these young talents who have shone through the quality of their research and who prove that the future of Algerian journalism is in very good hands. I would like to express my deep gratitude to the members of the jury for their rigor and professionalism, and I extend my warmest congratulations to all the winners, wishing them a successful journey."
Pour soutenir les lauréats dans leurs cu: To support the winners in their university courses and future projects, the company presented them with trophies accompanied by technological equipment including laptops and tablets. In conclusion of the gathering, the Minister of Communication presented his best wishes to media professionals on the occasion of National Press Day, celebrated on October 22.
